comment: The TeX Live package sets of lazytex. texlive/default.nix reads this file. docs/design.md, 'Where the TeX files come from', explains each part.
_hostedComment: The packages that lazytex's release hosts as archives. The build adds their dependencies and the packages of lazytex's bundle. docs/design.md, 'Hosted packages', has the criteria.
_generatedFilesComment: The files of texmf-var that pdfTeX reads. The index keeps only these, and an ls-R for each tree.
